killedBy: selectStorageNamespace can only ever move developer -> production, never the reverse
why: Reads `prodSave` OUTSIDE the gate. The observable result is the same for every URL -- which is why this is worth an entry rather than obvious -- because `parseDevFlags` already returns DEV_FLAGS_OFF without `dev=1`, so the flag is false there either way. What changes is the ORDER of the two questions, and with it the property that a query string can only ever move a session developer -> production and never the reverse. An entry that restructured the check while keeping the current parser's behaviour would slip through a table of inputs; the killing case sweeps the gate-less shapes of the flag instead.
